about: The postcommunio of the formulary “24th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, that all the evil in our hearts may be cured by the healing power of the sacrament we have received. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
